answer: Blind uniqueness tokens: before an agent can claim rewards at the zenith of an epoch, it must spend one unforgeable token issued by an independent grove of rotating issuers. Each issuer rate-limits minting and charges a real fee or proof-of-work per token, so a nebula of fake identities costs N times that fee. Tokens are blinded at issue and double-spend checked on redemption; splitting into clones cannot share one token, and a compromised issuer is rotated out without moving prior spends.
